$comment: The Cloudflare token this project's deploy steps need, expressed as data.
There is no dashboard upload for this; scripts/cloudflare-token.mjs resolves the names
to permission-group ids for the account and creates the token through the API.
Account API Tokens:Edit is deliberately absent: a deploy token that can mint tokens
turns one leaked secret into permanent access. Bootstrap one by hand, then rotate.
name: edapex-deploy

why.Workers Scripts:Edit: wrangler deploy for edapex-api, cowork-api and model-router, plus wrangler secret put
why.Workers Queues:Edit: edapex-push and edapex-push-dead, and the PUSH_QUEUE producer/consumer binding
why.D1:Edit: wrangler d1 create/migrations apply/execute for DB and AGENT_DB
why.Workers R2 Storage:Edit: edapex-media and sync media buckets, object upload and the public photo route
why.Account Settings:Read: account id and the membership the CLI warns about
why.Workers Routes:Edit: the two custom domains: api.llacademy.ng and edapex-api.llacademy.ng
why.Zone:Read: resolve the zone for those custom domains
